migration.note: User device confirmed Test26 delivery is now real, then exposed three product issues: more replies no longer open correctly, author directory is unusable, and the main home/detail action rows still look like plain text buttons. Test27 keeps Test24 avatar/runtime and Test26 creator baseline, replaces replies with one-request per-reply parsing plus no-empty-cache, reuses Provider.search(type=artist) for author discovery with recent-author fallback, and adds repository-hosted SVG icons to the five home tabs and four detail primary actions. Cloud import artifacts are build-locked to 20027.
